---
title: "Interest Rate Central"
---


Implied policy rate paths and meeting-by-meeting probability distributions derived from daily short-term interest rate futures settlement data.

## Available Central Bank Models

* [**US Federal Reserve (FOMC)**](rates_fed.qmd)  
  30-Day Fed Funds Futures (`ZQ`) on CBOT bootstrapped via Regularized WLS.

* [**European Central Bank (ECB)**](rates_ecb.qmd)  
  3-Month €STR Futures (`ST3`) on Eurex deaveraged via Regularized WLS.

* **Bank of England (BoE)** *(Planned)*  
  3-Month SONIA Futures (`SON`) on ICE Europe.

* **Bank of Japan (BoJ)** *(Planned)*  
  3-Month TONA Futures (`TONA`) on OSE.
